sections.text_helper: Section 25.7.23 "EXTI external interrupt selection register 2 (EXTI_EXTICR2)" in chapter 25 (Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1153.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x064
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)
Bits 31:24 EXTI7[7:0]: EXTI7 GPIO port selection.
These bits are written by software to select the source input for EXTI7 external interrupt.
0x00: PA7 pin
0x01: PB7 pin
0x02: PC7 pin
0x03: PD7 pin
0x04: PE7 pin
0x05: PF7 pin
0x06: PG7 pin
0x07: PH7 pin
0x08: PN7 pin
0x09: PO7 pin
0x0A: PP7 pin
0x0B: PQ7 pin
Others: reserved
l When SEC7 is disabled in EXTI_SECCFGR1 this field can be accessed with non-secure
and secure access.
l When SEC7 is enabled in EXTI_SECCFGR1, this field can be accessed only with secure
access. Nonsecure write is discarded, nonsecure read returns 0.
l When PRIV7 is disabled in EXTI_PRIVCFGR1, this field can be accessed with privileged
and unprivileged access.
l When PRIV7 is enabled in EXTI_PRIVCFGR1, this field can be accessed only with
privileged access. Unprivileged write to this field is discarded and read returns 0.
